note: Conejos Peak RD, Rio Grande NF: 1 mi west of Platoro at 10,000 ft in the Conejos River drainage, below Platoro Reservoir's dam, with the Mix Lake Overlook on site. Reached by FSR 250, either 23 mi up the Conejos from CO-17 or over Stunner Pass from the Alamosa River side. Access point for the South San Juan Wilderness. --Claude

ACCESS / STORM DAMAGE (Oct 22-23, 2026): Rio Grande NF Current Conditions (updated 2026-10-27): 'FSR 250 between Stunner to Highway 17 has damage - 4WD is recommended - Conejos Peak Ranger District' and 'Forest System Road (FSR) 250 between the Alamosa Guard Station and the Science Camp is impassable - road damage'. Mix Lake sits on FSR 250 between CO-17 and Stunner, so the Conejos approach is currently inside the 4WD-recommended stretch, and the Alamosa River approach is impassable. A storm-damage notice, not a standing agency recommendation; the campground is closed for the season ('Will resume Memorial Day weekend 2027'). Recheck before 2027.
